verdict_reason: The new sumAddressCounts sum test is sound, but its second test cannot fail (a Major test-readability finding).

todos.issue: 'keeps an empty tab in the sum' cannot fail: sumAddressCounts([7, 0, 0]) is 7 whether the zero tabs are kept or dropped, so no change to sumAddressCounts that drops empty tabs turns it red. It repeats the 'adds the counts of the tabs' case with zeros.
todos.fix: Must: every sumAddressCounts test can fail on a change to its body, and its title states what it proves. One way: delete the test, or replace it with 'is 0 when every tab is empty' asserting sumAddressCounts([0, 0, 0]) is 0 (fails if the reduce loses its 0 start).
